Marta Lindqvist
Backend and AI engineer, Gothenburg, Sweden (remote within Europe)

Summary
Software engineer with 4 years of professional experience, the last two on LLM features used by real customers. Python first, comfortable with Postgres, queues and cloud deployments.

Experience
Nordlys Commerce, AI Engineer, 2024 to present
- Built the product-question assistant for a fashion webshop: retrieval over 38,000 catalogue items with pgvector, answers in Swedish and English.
- Cut the share of "out of stock" hallucinations from 9% to 2% by adding an exact SKU and size lookup before semantic search and a grounding check on the final answer.
- Reduced median answer latency from 4.1 s to 2.3 s by caching embeddings, trimming the prompt and streaming the first sentence.
- Set up Langfuse tracing for every conversation and a golden set of 220 questions that runs in CI before each prompt change.
- Wrote a reranking step with a cross-encoder; recall at 5 went from 0.71 to 0.84 on the golden set.

Fjord Logistics, Backend Engineer, 2022 to 2024
- Owned the shipment-tracking API in Python and FastAPI, serving 1.2 million requests per day.
- Moved a nightly batch job to a queue-based pipeline, which brought the data delay from 6 hours to 15 minutes.
- Mentored two junior developers and ran the weekly code review.

Projects
- Open-source eval harness for retrieval systems: 140 GitHub stars, used by two other teams at Nordlys Commerce.
- Side project: Italian-language recipe chatbot, built to learn how multilingual prompts fail.

Education
BSc Computer Science, Chalmers University of Technology, 2022

Skills
Python, FastAPI, Postgres and pgvector, Qdrant, Langfuse, prompt and eval design, Docker, AWS
Languages: Swedish (native), English (fluent), Italian (conversational)
